Nora (People Ops): @vitor quick update: BG flagged a name mismatch between your passport and the gov tax record. I know you mentioned a consulate appointment next week. Can you confirm options so we don't delay your start?

Vitor (New Hire): Morning! Yes I have a consulate notary slot on Wed 11:30am BRT. I can also do a short recorded video bit earlier if that helps.

Liam (HR): Consulate notarization is the cleanest for Brazil-intl cases. If we can get a sealed notarized copy couriered afterwards that's ideal. Video-only is acceptable for provisional access but Legal prefers consulate docs on file within 7 days.

Nora (People Ops): Proposed flow: 1) provisional verification via recorded 5-min Zoom today so IT can enable cloud accounts, 2) consulate notarized copy couriered within 7 days for full I-9 closure, 3) benefits start deferred until notarized docs received (but prorated back to your start date). Good?

Vitor (New Hire): That works. I can do Zoom at 2pm BRT today. Courier available through my local notary (they provide tracked DHL sealed envelope). Do you need a notarized affidavit template?

Liam (HR): Yes please use this affidavit script in the video and the consulate package: 

```
I, [Full Name], affirm that the passport shown and the tax record presented are my legal identity documents. I consent to Redwood Inference storing this recording and the notarized copy for onboarding verification.
```

Nora (People Ops): Vitor fill this exception intake: https://forms.redwood.com/i9-exception (select "intl-consulate"). We'll tag it in the sheet as `consulate-sealed-dhl`.

Onboard-Bot: New case created: BG-9981. Status: provisional-verified.

Dana (IT): Note from IT: we can enable SSO, email, and dev sandbox after the recorded Zoom. We will not ship laptop or activate VPN until we receive the sealed notarized copy. Badge activation requires the sealed document.

Vitor (New Hire): Zoom done and recording uploaded to the secure intake link. Link: https://files.redwood.com/secure/UPLOAD-XYZ (placeholder). I selected the consulate option on the form and scheduled DHL pickup for Thu.

Nora (People Ops): Received recording. Marking provisional access granted. Adding note to Onboard Exceptions sheet: `consulate-sealed-dhl`, start date: unchanged, benefits: deferred-to-notary (prorated).

Liam (HR): I'll email Legal to flag expected consulate doc arrival and request expedited review. If DHL tracking confirms delivery within 7 days we should be good.

Dana (IT): Provisioning done. Email and cloud accounts created. ETA for laptop is hold-until-verified. I'll DM Vitor MFA steps.

Vitor (New Hire): Thanks team! Will update once DHL tracking shows delivered. Appreciate the provisional access. :smile:

Nora (People Ops): Closing loop steps: 1) track DHL, 2) update BG case when notarized copy scanned, 3) IT ships laptop and activates badge. I'll post back when step 2 completes. :white_check_mark:
